name: Lassi (sweet)
description: Churned yogurt whipped with water and sugar.

ayurveda.note: Churning + dilution tempers dahi's heat, say the texts — sweet lassi lands cooling-ish.

nutrition.highlight: yogurt thinned until it can be drunk

effects.note: Lassi is yogurt itself, churned and thinned with water, milk and sugar, carrying the same live cultures credited with yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — untested directly, but not a different food from the yogurt the trials used, just a sweetened, more dilute serving of it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
